## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Evidence

State the experiment ID, population/folds, before/after metrics, runtime/cache
conditions, and the decision. Link aggregate reports; do not paste dataset rows.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Output validator passes if prediction generation changed.
- [ ] Data, row-level artifacts, caches, and secrets are excluded.
- [ ] Documentation and experiment evidence reflect the actual run.

## Limitations

Record unverified behavior or remaining work.
